2027-05-02.title: Fifth Sunday after Qyomtho
readings: The Spirit of truth will guide you
Rejoice before the Lord at the feast of weeks
David becomes great, for the Lord was with him
Filled with joy and the Holy Spirit
Seek the things that are above
Your pain will turn into joy
2027-05-02.verse: So you have pain now; but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.

2027-05-06.title: Suloko · The Ascension of our Lord
readings: The tablets placed in the ark
Elijah taken up; Elisha takes his mantle
I will write my law on their hearts
He was lifted up, and a cloud took him
He blessed them and was carried up into heaven
2027-05-06.verse: While he was blessing them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

2027-05-09.title: Sixth Sunday after Qyomtho
readings: I am the Lord; I will free you
Your immortal spirit is in all things
I have swept away your sins like a cloud
The eyes of your heart enlightened
It is to your advantage that I go away
2027-05-09.verse: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

2027-05-16.title: The Sunday of Pentecost
readings: The Advocate will teach you everything
The spirit rests on the seventy elders
The land divided among the tribes
The spirit of God comes upon Saul
A new heart and a new spirit
Varieties of gifts, the same Spirit
Another Advocate, to be with you for ever
2027-05-16.verse: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them ability.

2027-05-23.title: First Sunday after Pentecost
readings: The manna ceases; they eat the produce of the land
Filled with the spirit of the Lord
Plans for your welfare, a future with hope
The Bereans examine the Scriptures daily
2027-05-23.verse: By contrast, the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, generosity, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.

2027-05-30.title: Second Sunday after Pentecost
readings: You shall be holy, for I am holy
David becomes king over all Israel
The exiles weep, fast and pray
The living God, whose kingdom shall never be destroyed
I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh
No condemnation for those in Christ Jesus
Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it
2027-05-30.verse: Whoever does not take up the cross and follow me is not worthy of me. Those who find their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake will find it.

2027-05-01.title: Mar Yauseph, Patron of Workers · Jeremiah the Prophet · Saturday of the fourth week after Qyomtho
readings: We worked night and day; anyone unwilling to work should not eat
“Is not this the carpenter’s son?”; a prophet without honour in his own country
2027-05-01.verse: Is not this the carpenter’s son? Is not his mother called Mary?

2027-05-03.title: Monday of the fifth week after Qyomtho
readings: Now is the acceptable time; as having nothing, and yet possessing everything
“I am the light of the world”
2027-05-03.verse: See, now is the acceptable time; see, now is the day of salvation!

2027-05-04.title: Tuesday of the fifth week after Qyomtho
readings: Gentle like a nurse; sharing not only the gospel but our own selves
“Whoever keeps my word will never see death”
2027-05-04.verse: So deeply do we care for you that we are determined to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own selves, because you have become very dear to us.

2027-05-05.title: Wednesday of the fifth week after Qyomtho
readings: Pray for us; the Lord is faithful and will guard you from the evil one
Your eye is the lamp of your body
2027-05-05.verse: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

2027-05-07.title: The Finding of the Cross of our Lord · First Friday · Friday after Suloko
readings: May I never boast of anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
The treasure hidden in a field; the pearl of great value
2027-05-07.verse: May I never boast of anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

2027-05-08.title: Mar Yohannan Shleeha · St John the Apostle · Saturday after Suloko
readings: Who will separate us from the love of Christ?
The disciple whom Jesus loved; “Follow me!”
2027-05-08.verse: This is the disciple who is testifying to these things and has written them, and we know that his testimony is true.

2027-05-10.title: Mar Shemun Shleeha the Zealot · St Simon the Apostle · Monday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: Paul stays in Ephesus until Pentecost: a wide door for effective work has opened
Zacchaeus: today salvation has come to this house
2027-05-10.verse: For the Son of Man came to seek out and to save the lost.

2027-05-11.title: Sts Cyril and Methodius of the Slav peoples · Tuesday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: God's plan to gather up all things in Christ; sealed with the promised Holy Spirit
Jesus prays all night on the mountain and chooses the Twelve
2027-05-11.verse: In him you also, when you had heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and had believed in him, were marked with the seal of the promised Holy Spirit

2027-05-12.title: Mar Epiphanios of Cyprus · Mar Yaqob, bishop and Malpan of Nisibis · Wednesday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: Work out your salvation, for God is at work in you; shine like stars in the world
Interpret the present time; settle with your accuser on the way
2027-05-12.verse: for it is God who is at work in you, enabling you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

2027-05-13.title: Mar Ishaq Malpan of Antioch · St Isaac of Antioch · Thursday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: God's promise and oath; hope, a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul
“Let anyone who is thirsty come to me”: rivers of living water, the Spirit
2027-05-13.verse: We have this hope, a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul

2027-05-14.title: Mar Addai Shleeha · St Addai the Apostle of Edessa · Friday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: I have learned to be content; I can do all things through him who strengthens me
What is whispered will be proclaimed from the housetops; do not be afraid
2027-05-14.verse: Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.

2027-05-15.title: The Holy Mother of God for the ears of grain · Mar Pachomios · Saturday of the sixth week after Qyomtho
readings: The one who sows bountifully will reap bountifully; God loves a cheerful giver
“Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”
2027-05-15.verse: Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it!

2027-05-17.title: Monday after the Sunday of Pentecost
readings: Live your life in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ
The Twelve are sent: “You received without payment; give without payment”
2027-05-17.verse: Only, live your life in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ

2027-05-18.title: Tuesday after the Sunday of Pentecost
readings: He shared our flesh and blood, to be a merciful and faithful high priest
The woman who lights a lamp and searches for the lost coin
2027-05-18.verse: Because he himself was tested by what he suffered, he is able to help those who are being tested.

2027-05-19.title: Memory of Mar Yaqob Shleeha's first offering of the Holy Qurbono · Wednesday after the Sunday of Pentecost
readings: “Do this in remembrance of me”: the Lord's Supper handed on
“I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you”
2027-05-19.verse: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

2027-05-20.title: The Four Evangelists · Thursday after the Sunday of Pentecost
readings: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”; faith comes from what is heard
“Go therefore and make disciples of all nations”; “I am with you always”
2027-05-20.verse: So faith comes from what is heard, and what is heard comes through the word of Christ.

2027-05-21.title: Golden Friday · the first Friday after Pentecost · St Helena the Queen
readings: “I have no silver or gold, but what I have I give you”: the lame man at the Beautiful Gate
If I do not have love, I am nothing
The camel and the eye of a needle; “for God all things are possible”
2027-05-21.verse: I have no silver or gold, but what I have I give you; in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, stand up and walk.

2027-05-22.title: Saturday after the Sunday of Pentecost · St Rita
readings: “You are a letter of Christ... written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God”
The wise and foolish bridesmaids: “Keep awake therefore”
2027-05-22.verse: you show that you are a letter of Christ, prepared by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

2027-05-24.title: Monday of the first week after Pentecost
readings: No longer strangers: built together into a dwelling place for God
They loved human glory more than the glory that comes from God
2027-05-24.verse: in whom you also are built together spiritually into a dwelling place for God.

2027-05-25.title: Tuesday of the first week after Pentecost · St Sophia
readings: We do not lose heart; we look at what cannot be seen
The parable of the pounds: “Do business with these until I come back”
2027-05-25.verse: So we do not lose heart. Even though our outer nature is wasting away, our inner nature is being renewed day by day.

2027-05-26.title: Wednesday of the first week after Pentecost · St Philip Neri
readings: You accepted it not as a human word but as what it really is, God's word
“Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life”
2027-05-26.verse: Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life.

2027-05-27.title: Thursday of the first week after Pentecost
readings: Seek the things that are above; your life is hidden with Christ in God
The woman who touched the fringe of his clothes: “Daughter, your faith has made you well”
2027-05-27.verse: for you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

2027-05-28.title: Friday of the first week after Pentecost
readings: Timothy sent to strengthen and encourage you, so that no one would be shaken
The poor widow put in everything she had, all she had to live on
2027-05-28.verse: she out of her poverty has put in everything she had, all she had to live on.

2027-05-29.title: Saturday of the first week after Pentecost · St Theodosia
readings: Appoint elders in every town: a bishop, as God's steward, must be blameless
Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple
2027-05-29.verse: Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

2027-05-31.title: Monday of the second week after Pentecost
readings: Your faith is growing abundantly, and your love for one another is increasing
“This is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent”
2027-05-31.verse: And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.

Two brothers and a new alphabet
The bishop and his medicine chest
Mar Addai and the sick king

The four evangelists and their animals
St Helena, the queen who built churches
St Rita and the rose in winter
St Philip Neri and the feathers
